description: Pre-judged calibration examples with anchored 1-5 ground-truth scores. Each calibration status contains six checks (three examples x verdict and total): all six must pass before a live result counts. Scores must remain within one point of each anchor.

examples.description: A component-states output that covers all dimensions with specific values and evidence.
examples.excerpt: Loading state: aria-busy=true set on the button container; spinner visible but button label unchanged ('Delete account'). No double-submit: pointer-events:none applied at pressed-down; repeat click on Enter key returns immediately without re-firing. Success: aria-live='polite' announces 'Account deleted' after 200ms; focus moves to the next interactive element. Evidence: Tested with VoiceOver on macOS 14, keyboard-only traversal, and NVDA+Firefox 124. Provenance: design spec §4.2 and WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.3.
examples.anchor_rationale: Exact values (aria-busy, 200ms, §4.2), all five evidence fields, no invented scope.

examples.description: A deslop-ui output that lists checks as ticks without evidence.
examples.excerpt:
✓ Gradient removed
✓ Hero recentered
✓ Cards differentiated
✓ Typography replaced
All checks passed.
examples.anchor_rationale: Bare checkmarks. No reason, remediation, evidence, or provenance. Cannot determine if checks were actually executed.

examples.description: A tastecheck-pass output with most evidence but one n/a without reason.
examples.excerpt:
Contrast: measured #1C4A6E on #FFFFFF = 8.7:1. PASS. Evidence: Chrome DevTools color picker, Axe 4.8.2. Provenance: WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3.
Error state: n/a
Motion: reduced-motion media query present. PASS. Evidence: CSS @media (prefers-reduced-motion). Provenance: WCAG 2.1 SC 2.3.3.
examples.anchor_rationale: n/a without subject-absence reason violates fail-closed. Evidence otherwise strong but the unsupported skip forces a 0 on fail_closed.
